runtimesToInstall.description: All runtimes in this list will be installed on the node if they are not already installed

embedderModelsToInstall.description: All {@link GenaiCore.Embedder.Hf} models in this list will be installed on the node if they are not already installed

retrieverToInitialize.description:
The `name` of the {@link Genai.Retriever} of type #retrieverTypeName to initialize.
Note that if #initializeDefaultProjectSettings is true, then the retrievers for
both projects will be initialized without needing to specify them here.

retrieverTypeName.description: The name of the type of retriever to use.

initializeDefaultProjectSettings.description:
If set true, then `initializeProjects` will be called on the default
{@link Genai.Project} for the app.

setupLambdas.description: Additional lambdas that should be executed. These should be idempotent.
